title: Nordic.js 2014 • Douglas Crockford - The Better Parts
summary: Douglas Crockford's Nordic.js 2014 talk on 'the better parts' of JavaScript and programming in general. He argues against `this`, `new` and ES6 classes, and for classless, composition-based object patterns, with some broader remarks on building better structures for the future.
why: HN commenters cite it whenever JavaScript classes, `this` or inheritance come up, as the clearest case for classless OOP from Crockford.

quote.text: It's possible to write javascript without `this`, a style preferred e.g. by Douglas Crockford, explained in the video below.
